song_craft: Bound-to-means song (6v): called bound → stations gained → teeming fancy → feast-abiding → child-shown one → self-way. Tenderness (vatsa) inside rigor.

lines: Action-mind narrowed, gained — then called bound soul;
thus by will, blessed Bhairava is measured.
l4.sanskrit_cite: karmabuddhyakṣatāṃ prāptā tadāsau paśur ucyate | itīcchayā sa bhagavān bhairavaḥ parimīyate

lines: Narrowed in work, being — that power follows him;
his Lord-of-Wisdom, Ever-Blest, Śiva-hoods — body, breath, mind, void, knowerhood gained.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mitavṛttis satī sā ca śaktis tam anuvartate | tasya vidyeśasādākhyaśivatās saṃkucatsthiteḥ
